article.title: Conversion from firm into limited liability partnership.
article.content: A firm may convert into a limited liability partnership in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter and the Second Schedule.
article.html:
55Conversion from firm into limited liability partnership.

Section 55 · Chapter X · page 22 of the Act

A firm may convert into a limited liability partnership in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter and the Second Schedule.
